elements.text: Introduce the cast of your life this year. Include close friends or family members who were there for key moments.
Recap how the year started. Describe the overall vibe of the first few months, and highlight any standout moments.
Describe the first big unexpected event of your year. It could be a new job, a new relationship, or a major trip.
Highlight habits or funny repeated events that became your year’s inside jokes.Use numbers or examples if possible.

Mention any new people, groups, or communities you joined this year.
Share travel moments, new hangout spots, or cities you visited with these “guests.”
